scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist-electron/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'})); if (!fs.existsSync('dist-electron/resources')) fs.mkdirSync('dist-electron/resources', {recursive:true}); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('electron/resources')) fs.copyFileSync('electron/resources/'+f, 'dist-electron/resources/'+f);"
scripts.electron:preview: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node -e "process.env.NODE_ENV='production'; require('child_process').spawn('npx', ['electron', '.'], {stdio: 'inherit', shell: true})"
